svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut two 2,940 mm lengths of 75 x 150 mm; treat the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Each lies on edge across the store on one pair of post cap plates,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: sloping 4 degrees down toward the right side.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: It overhangs 70 mm past each post centre.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fix: two M10 x 100 mm coach screws up through each cap plate.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Mark the five purlin positions on the top edge: 700 mm apart

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: along the slope, the outer two 1,400 mm from the middle.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: both beams parallel, 3,700 mm apart centre to centre,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: diagonals across the four post tops within 10 mm.
